scenarios.Colorize: Colorize this black-and-white photograph with vivid, saturated, popping colors. Preserve the original composition, lighting, and facial features. Make the colors rich and vibrant, bold and eye-catching, with strong saturation and contrast.
scenarios.Restore: Restore this old, damaged photograph. Repair scratches, tears, creases, and fading. Reconstruct missing details naturally. Stay faithful to the original subjects and composition.
scenarios.Remove marks: Remove the watermark, stamps, signatures, and handwritten annotations from this image. Reconstruct the underlying background seamlessly and naturally.
scenarios.De-blur: Restore sharp focus to this blurry photograph. Recover fine detail cleanly without adding artifacts or altering the original content.
scenarios.Clean scan: Clean up this photographed document. Straighten the perspective, even out the lighting, remove shadows and background clutter, and make the text crisp and high-contrast.
scenarios.Sketch to photo: Turn this sketch into a photorealistic photograph. Keep the composition and subject exactly as drawn. Add realistic textures, lighting, and color.
scenarios.Cutout: Isolate the main subject of this image on a fully transparent background. Keep edges clean and preserve fine detail such as hair and fur.

boosters.Sharp & clean: sharp focus, crisp fine details, high resolution, clean rendering
boosters.No artifacts: no compression artifacts, no watermark, no text overlays, no stray marks
boosters.Correct anatomy: correct anatomy, correct hands and fingers, natural proportions
boosters.Studio quality: professional studio lighting, balanced exposure, clean background
